setup: Seat so your shoulders line up with the pivots
Pads against your upper arms near the elbows
Chest on or back against the pad, feet flat
execution: Lead with your elbows out to the sides
Raise until upper arms are level
Lower slowly; keep a little tension
faults: Don't rock your torso for momentum
Don't let the stack slam down

notes: Line the shoulder joint up with the machine's pivot; a poor seat height drags the shoulder through an awkward path.
Pick a lighter weight than you expect and keep the reps strict.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move

keyPositions.label: Bottom
keyPositions.describe: Seated tall, arms by the sides with elbows bent, pads resting on the outside of the upper arms near the elbows.

keyPositions.label: Top
keyPositions.describe: Arms raised out to the sides until the upper arms are level with the shoulders, pads pushed up. Shoulders down, not shrugged; torso still.
